name: nextra-axisvm
description: Six token-lean tools (view, query, edit, run, undo, memory) for AxisVM, on the model you have open.
long_description: Talks to AxisVM through PyAxisVM/COM. The NextraAxisVM add-on (installed by the setup, which runs automatically on first use) lets the tools reach an AxisVM you opened yourself. Windows only.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: full = all 6 tools, ask = read-only (view + query)

tools.name: view
tools.description: Tagged model image with grid, results overlay, or AxisVM window capture

tools.name: query
tools.description: Model, loads, results, catalog, API reference, docs, status (dialogs)

tools.name: run
tools.description: Python with PyAxisVM on the open model, delta + checkpoint

tools.name: memory
tools.description: Preferences, workflows, learned rules, script library
